heading: The look: the pub and the quizmaster
intro: Six looks, two takes each, built in Flow from your Unsplash pub photos (as layout) with clean-room prompts. Every quizmaster mask checked up close: three needed a fix pass (shown). Pick one per row, or note what to change; a note on any row is read as an instruction.
